description: The file defines a generic data access object (DAO) implementation for handling BaseOpenmrsData entities in the OpenMRS system, providing methods to retrieve all entities, retrieve a subset with pagination, and count entities, with optional filtering for voided entities.

classes.name: HibernateOpenmrsDataDAO
classes.description: A generic DAO class implementing data retrieval methods for BaseOpenmrsData entities, supporting filtering by 'voided' status and pagination.

methods.name: HibernateOpenmrsDataDAO
methods.description: Constructor initializing the DAO with the specific entity class.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all entities, optionally filtering out voided records.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of entities, optionally filtering out voided records.

methods.name: getAllCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of entities, optionally excluding voided ones.
